name: V4 - Construction Operations Health
description: Portfolio template: AI-enriched construction inquiry intake with idempotency, Groq classification, deterministic rules, HubSpot Contact/Deal synchronization, retries, fallbacks, and persistent audit status.

parameters.jsCode:
const rows = $input.all().map((item) => item.json).filter((row) => row?.inquiry_id);
return [{ json: { inquiry_snapshot: rows, collected_at: new Date().toISOString() } }];

return $input.all().map((item) => ({ json: {
  health: item.json.health,
  health_reasons: item.json.health_reasons,
  decision: item.json.alert_decision.reason,
  delivery_status: item.json.alert_delivery.status,
  provider_called: item.json.alert_delivery.attempted,
  provider_message_id: item.json.alert_delivery.provider_message_id || null,
  fingerprint: item.json.operational_alert.fingerprint,
  incident_status: item.json.alert_state_write.status,
  notification_count: item.json.alert_state_write.notification_count,
  cooldown_until: item.json.alert_state_write.cooldown_until || null,
  state_persisted: item.json.alert_state_persisted,
} }));
